studies.title: The Phoenician alphabet
studies.caption: Phoenician scribes write with twenty-two letters for consonants alone, simple enough for merchants to learn.
studies.prompt: Close eye-level study of a Phoenician merchant and scribe in Byblos about1050BCE, reed pen making short angular marks on a small papyrus sheet beside amphora cargo. Focus hands and writing materials; no modern Latin alphabet, bound books, or readable lettering.
